stable.notes: You can now finish naming a voice. Typing a name and choosing a scope had no way to save it: the only way to commit was clicking a suggested profile, and often no suggestion could appear. Two fixes — confirm a name the system proposed but was not confident enough to show, and use a name that belongs to someone not yet enrolled. A confirmed voice keeps its caveats: if it swaps with another speaker, it still says so. Needs server 6.21.25.
